description: Hide and seek! Help Bunny and Robo find Duck from sound and tail clues, and learn the words in, under, behind, beside and on. Then Robo tries to hide, and he is far too big!

youtube.title: Where Is Duck? 🦆 In, On, Under, Behind | Position Words for Kids | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Let's play hide and seek! Duck hides and you are the seeker. Listen for a quack, look for a peeking tail, and find Duck in the box, under the table, behind the tree, beside Chick and on the roof. Then Robo tries to hide behind a tiny bush. Can you see him?

Try it at home with a grown-up: put a soft toy in, on, under, behind or beside a box when you hear the word, then swap. Play in one room, and never hide in anything that closes, like a fridge, a washing machine or a car.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: Ready or not, here I come!
Rabbits' eyes are on the sides of their heads. Great for seeking!
Where is Duck? Can you help us look?
A quack! And the lid is wobbling.
In! Only her head is out.
Pat, pat, pat, pat. Where, oh where? Peek-a-quack! In!
One, two, three, four, five! Ready or not!
Hmm. Look low. What do you see?
A yellow tail is sticking out!
Pat, pat, pat, pat. Where, oh where? Peek-a-quack! Under!
A quack from this side! Bunny looks the other way.
A duck's eyes are on the sides of her head. She saw us first!
Pat, pat, pat, pat. Where, oh where? Peek-a-quack! Behind!
Last hiding spot. Close your eyes, Bunny!
Look at the yellow flowers. Look very closely!
Some animals hide by matching the colours around them.
Duck is beside Chick! Next to Chick.
Pat, pat, pat, pat. Where, oh where? Peek-a-quack! Beside!
Duck wants one more turn. Eyes closed!
The quack is coming from up high!
Duck is on the house! On the roof.
Pat, pat, pat, pat. Where, oh where? Peek-a-quack! On!
My turn to hide! Close your eyes.
Ready or not! Where is Robo?
Can you see Robo? Where is he?
Oops! Robots are too big for little bushes!
Now you! Put your hand on your head.
Seeker quiz! One. Where is the ball?
Two. Where is the ball now?
Three. Where is the ball now?
Four. Where is the ball now?
Never hide in things that close. Bye-bye!
